visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a male creator sitting in a cluttered indoor workspace, presenting a small titanium alcohol stove that is already burning with a steady blue flame. He gestures towards the stove and a grey camping mug with the brand name 'CAMPFIRE' clearly visible on its side. The lighting is warm and natural for an indoor setting, with headphones and papers visible in the background. (2) He picks up the unlit stove to demonstrate its mechanical design, showing how the three integrated legs can be folded and unfolded. His hands are in a close-up shot as he manipulates the metallic components, highlighting the stove's compact and lightweight structure. (3) The creator pours a pink industrial alcohol liquid from a translucent plastic bottle into the stove's central reservoir. He speaks directly to the camera, using hand gestures to emphasize the importance of fuel levels for preheating efficiency. (4) After lighting the stove with a blue lighter, he places the metal mug filled with water onto the supports. The camera captures the interaction between the intense blue flame and the bottom of the mug. (5) A series of extreme close-up shots show a smartphone displaying a timer and a digital infrared thermometer measuring the water temperature. The thermometer displays values around 94 degrees Celsius as steam begins to rise from the mug. (6) In the concluding phase, the creator blows out the flame with a visible puff of air. He uses a red silicone textured glove to safely lift the hot mug and discusses the final weight measurements of the remaining fuel.
